summary: Triple Flag Precious Metals Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a May 5, 2026 news release reporting record Q1 2026 results. The release details financial highlights, GEOs guidance, and corporate updates including an agreement with Evolution Mining to fund development of the E44 gold deposit at Northparkes and the acquisition of a 3.0% GR royalty on the Gunnison copper project. No specific deal terms are provided for these transactions. The filing is a routine earnings report with no special-situation event such as a takeover, activist campaign, or strategic review.
